provenance.notes: Zone H (R5-0n.S3): the two 14x14 arc-drone frames are cells 1 and 3 (prongs idle, arc fully lit) of the owner-picked BOLT DRONE animation sheet (four states idle/charging/fully-lit/fading in two rows of two with even gutters), cropped from the committed winner with a 6-px key border around each subject box; the lit cell differs from the idle cell by 4.5% of their union (the short violet arc between the forward prongs), the wide charging cell by 43.5% - the shipped pair keeps the drone body at a constant 1.06 aspect inside the square slot. The sheet's white gutter guide lines (luma 313) and the fading cell's detached sparks fall outside both crops. The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off. The BOLT DRONE was drawn on the TEMPEST RIDGE roster sheet but ships only in the zone-H roster (bolt-drone and sovereign-drone) - the owner handoff routes the drop to this lane.
